description: Returns one published product record: source-recorded composition with printed-disclosure verification status, daily amounts, a cohesive comparison with effective denominator, age policy, scope and percentage, and separate reference limits of other countries, the status in the country, prices per day where published, and the dates of each part.

country.description: Two-letter country for limits, status and published local prices. Defaults to the product URL country when supplied, otherwise the label market. Viewing a record does not confirm local sale or delivery.

id.description: Verateca product id, e.g. "US:302778", as returned by search_products.

period_days.description: Optional days of consumption, calculated from verified pack and daily-use basis. This is not a whole-pack checkout price.

url.description: Verateca product page address, as an alternative to id.

name: get_product
title: Get product
